collection.description: A villager prays for a sick friend, but the illness worsens.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A villager prays for a sick friend, but the illness worsens.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They wonder whether determination can help them act despite despair.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: They organize food, clean water, and practical care.

text_only.reason: food and care given to the friend; the village's food does not change

c.name: Answer C
c.text: They find meaning in the act of accompanying the sick friend.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: They review what treatments were attempted and what remains unknown.

r2.name: Resolution 2
r2.text: A second witness or unexpected detail complicates the simplest explanation.

r3.name: Resolution 3
r3.text: Another villager interprets the same evidence differently. Their exchange can deepen respect, cause a mild argument, or inspire a shared project.
